origin.rerun: pytest a run_cycle test with an 'open' ledger row whose terminal Position has stop_loss=None -- open while it raises no alert/halt.

what: OA-05/06 (MED, prop containment). Sub-agent read, not re-verified line by line. Two gaps. (1) An SL or TP that disappears AFTER a row reaches 'open' is never alerted. _contain only runs on watched states. _reconcile_journal skips the comparison when p.stop_loss is None (prop_executor.py ~2168), and prop_trail's alert text says 'containment will act', which is false for an open row. (2) The one SL/TP repair under ROLLOUT_GUARD always refuses ('current stop loss not readable', dxtrade.py ~5098) yet consumes leg_fix_tried. The flatten therefore waits a whole tick, and a failed flatten parks the row as 'contained', never retried (prop_executor.py ~2003-2031). Proposed fix (Tier-2): alert and halt on NAKED in _reconcile_journal; when the repair does not click, flatten in the same cycle; on a failed flatten keep the row 'unconfirmed' with a bounded retry; correct the two trail alert texts.
